FAQ

Does shipping Check In or share ETA auto-translate my China listing?

No. Check In and arrival-notification flows are on-device location and messaging behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback even when your US listing mentions Share ETA or Notify when I arrive.

How is this different from Find My or AirTag listing copy?

Find My markets item location, Find My network tracking, Lost Mode, and precision finding for accessories — 查找 and 丢失模式. Check In markets personal safety updates, share ETA with trusted contacts, and notify-when-I-arrive alerts — 安全签到 and 到达通知. Locating an object and telling someone you are safe en route are different buyer stories.

How is this different from Emergency SOS via Satellite or Crash Detection?

Emergency SOS via Satellite markets satellite messaging when cellular is unavailable — off-grid rescue. Crash Detection markets collision sensors and automatic emergency call after a crash. Check In markets proactive trip safety, ETA sharing, and arrival notifications to trusted contacts — not satellite SOS and not crash-sensor dial-out.

How is this different from Messages, NameDrop, or Share Sheet pages?

Messages covers chat and iMessage workflows. NameDrop covers contact-card exchange. Share Sheet covers system share menus. This page covers safety Check In, share ETA, and notify-when-I-arrive arrival alerts — not general messaging, not contact exchange, not generic share-menu marketing.
